SELECT count(DISTINCT r.process_key) AS value
FROM public.dim_process_registry r
WHERE LOWER(r.process_name) IN ('svchost.exe', 'lsass.exe', 'services.exe', 'wininit.exe', 'smss.exe', 'csrss.exe', 'explorer.exe')
  AND NOT starts_with(LOWER(r.executable_path), 'c:\windows\system32') 
  AND NOT starts_with(LOWER(r.executable_path), 'c:\windows\syswow64')
  AND NOT starts_with(LOWER(r.executable_path), 'c:\windows');

SELECT count(DISTINCT r.process_key) AS value
FROM public.fact_process_lifecycle_events e
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON e.process_key = r.process_key
WHERE e.event_type = 'START'
  AND r.is_elevated = 1
  AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp);

SELECT count(*) AS value
FROM public.fact_process_lifecycle_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'EXIT'
  AND e.exit_code IS NOT NULL 
  AND e.exit_code <> '0x00000000'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp);

SELECT count(*) AS value
FROM public.fact_process_lifecycle_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'EXIT' 
  AND e.process_lifetime < 5
  AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp);

WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t_from,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t_to
),
interval_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    GREATEST(interval '10 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval) AS dt
  FROM time_bounds
),
time_grid AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.t_from) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.t_to) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) AS grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
),
state_aligned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.bucket_time)
    g.bucket_time,
    a.process_name
  FROM public.app_usage_logs a
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from a.start_time) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from (a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval)) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) g(bucket_time)
  WHERE a.start_time >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND a.start_time >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND a.start_time <= b.t_to AND a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval >= b.t_from
  ORDER BY g.bucket_time, a.start_time DESC
),
starts AS (
  SELECT 
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from event_timestamp) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz AS bucket_time,
    count(*) AS count_start
  FROM public.fact_process_lifecycle_events, time_bounds b, interval_calc i
  WHERE event_type = 'START'
    AND event_timestamp >= b.t_from AND event_timestamp <= b.t_to
  GROUP BY 1
),
exits AS (
  SELECT 
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from event_timestamp) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz AS bucket_time,
    count(*) AS count_exit
  FROM public.fact_process_lifecycle_events, time_bounds b, interval_calc i
  WHERE event_type = 'EXIT'
    AND event_timestamp >= b.t_from AND event_timestamp <= b.t_to
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  g.grid_time AS time,
  CASE 
    WHEN sa.process_name = 'System_Sleep' OR sa.process_name IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE COALESCE(s.count_start, 0)
  END AS "进程生成速率 (次)",
  CASE 
    WHEN sa.process_name = 'System_Sleep' OR sa.process_name IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE COALESCE(e.count_exit, 0)
  END AS "进程销毁速率 (次)"
FROM time_grid g
LEFT JOIN state_aligned sa ON sa.bucket_time = g.grid_time
LEFT JOIN starts s ON s.bucket_time = g.grid_time
LEFT JOIN exits e ON e.bucket_time = g.grid_time
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT 
  r.process_name AS "进程名",
  count(*) AS "发生频次 (次)",
  ROUND(AVG(e.process_lifetime)::numeric, 2) AS "平均存活时间 (秒)",
  r.executable_path AS "程序路径",
  r.command_line AS "命令行"
FROM public.fact_process_lifecycle_events e
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON e.process_key = r.process_key
WHERE e.event_type = 'EXIT' 
  AND e.process_lifetime < 5
  AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
GROUP BY r.process_name, r.executable_path, r.command_line
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 100;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  e.event_timestamp AS "启动时刻",
  r.process_name AS "提权进程名",
  r.parent_process AS "父进程名",
  CASE 
    WHEN r.signature_status = 1 THEN '✅ 已签名'
    WHEN r.signature_status = 0 THEN '❌ 无签名'
    ELSE '⚠️ 签名异常'
  END AS "数字签名",
  r.executable_path AS "可执行文件路径",
  r.command_line AS "提权命令行"
FROM public.fact_process_lifecycle_events e
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON e.process_key = r.process_key
WHERE e.event_type = 'START'
  AND r.is_elevated = 1
  AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
ORDER BY e.event_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
  r.created_at AS "首次发现时间",
  r.process_name AS "可疑进程",
  CASE 
    WHEN r.signature_status = 1 THEN '✅ 已签名'
    WHEN r.signature_status = 0 THEN '❌ 无签名'
    ELSE '⚠️ 签名校验异常'
  END AS "数字签名",
  CASE 
    WHEN LOWER(r.process_name) IN ('svchost.exe', 'lsass.exe', 'services.exe', 'wininit.exe', 'smss.exe', 'csrss.exe', 'explorer.exe')
         AND NOT starts_with(LOWER(r.executable_path), 'c:\windows\system32') 
         AND NOT starts_with(LOWER(r.executable_path), 'c:\windows\syswow64')
         AND NOT starts_with(LOWER(r.executable_path), 'c:\windows') THEN '🔥 严重仿冒系统文件！'
    WHEN r.signature_status = 0 
         AND (starts_with(LOWER(r.executable_path), 'c:\users\') 
              OR starts_with(LOWER(r.executable_path), 'c:\programdata\') 
              OR position('\temp\' in LOWER(r.executable_path)) > 0) THEN '⚠️ 用户目录无签名运行'
    ELSE 'ℹ️ 可疑运行特征'
  END AS "风险判定",
  r.executable_path AS "可执行文件路径",
  r.command_line AS "执行命令行",
  COALESCE(r.parent_process, '未知') AS "父进程"
FROM public.dim_process_registry r
WHERE (r.signature_status <= 0 
       OR (LOWER(r.process_name) IN ('svchost.exe', 'lsass.exe', 'services.exe', 'explorer.exe')
           AND NOT starts_with(LOWER(r.executable_path), 'c:\windows')))
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  e.event_timestamp AS "崩溃时刻",
  r.process_name AS "崩溃程序",
  e.exit_code AS "原始退出码",
  CASE 
    WHEN e.exit_code = '0xC0000005' THEN '🔥 内存越界访问 (Access Violation)'
    WHEN e.exit_code = '0xC00000FD' THEN '🔥 栈溢出错误 (Stack Overflow)'
    WHEN e.exit_code = '0xC0000094' THEN '🛑 整数除以零错误 (Divide by Zero)'
    WHEN e.exit_code = '0xC000013A' THEN '💤 用户按 Ctrl+C 强行终止'
    WHEN e.exit_code = '0xC0000142' THEN '🛠️ DLL 库初始化失败'
    WHEN e.exit_code = '0xC0000374' THEN '🔥 堆内存损坏 (Heap Corrupt)'
    ELSE '⚠️ 其他非正常退出码 (' || e.exit_code || ')'
  END AS "崩溃原因翻译",
  e.process_lifetime AS "存活寿命 (秒)",
  r.executable_path AS "程序路径",
  r.command_line AS "命令行"
FROM public.fact_process_lifecycle_events e
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON e.process_key = r.process_key
WHERE e.event_type = 'EXIT' 
  AND e.exit_code IS NOT NULL 
  AND e.exit_code <> '0x00000000'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
ORDER BY e.event_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
  e.event_timestamp AS "执行时刻",
  r.process_name AS "LOLBin 进程",
  r.parent_process AS "父进程",
  r.command_line AS "执行命令行",
  CASE 
    WHEN LOWER(r.command_line) LIKE '%http://%' OR LOWER(r.command_line) LIKE '%https://%' THEN '🔴 触发远程下载'
    WHEN LOWER(r.executable_path) LIKE '%users%' AND LOWER(r.process_name) IN ('regsvr32.exe', 'rundll32.exe', 'mshta.exe') THEN '⚠️ 影子目录装载'
    ELSE 'ℹ️ 可疑脚本运行'
  END AS "威胁类别",
  r.executable_path AS "程序路径"
FROM public.fact_process_lifecycle_events e
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON e.process_key = r.process_key
WHERE e.event_type = 'START'
  AND (
    LOWER(r.process_name) IN ('certutil.exe', 'bitsadmin.exe', 'mshta.exe', 'regsvr32.exe', 'rundll32.exe', 'curl.exe', 'wscript.exe', 'cscript.exe', 'powershell.exe')
    AND (
      LOWER(r.command_line) LIKE '%http%'
      OR LOWER(r.command_line) LIKE '%-nop%'
      OR LOWER(r.command_line) LIKE '%-w hidden%'
      OR LOWER(r.command_line) LIKE '%-enc%'
      OR LOWER(r.command_line) LIKE '%javascript:%'
      OR LOWER(r.command_line) LIKE '%vbscript:%'
      OR LOWER(r.command_line) LIKE '%/i:http%'
    )
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
ORDER BY e.event_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50;

panels.title: 🛡️ LOLBins 滥用与高危脚本审计

targets.rawSql:
WITH sensitive_focus AS (
  SELECT 
    timestamp,
    end_timestamp,
    window_title
  FROM public.fact_process_context
  WHERE (
    LOWER(window_title) LIKE '%keepass%'
    OR LOWER(window_title) LIKE '%password%'
    OR LOWER(window_title) LIKE '%bitwarden%'
    OR LOWER(window_title) LIKE '%terminal%'
    OR LOWER(window_title) LIKE '%powershell%'
    OR LOWER(window_title) LIKE '%mxtoolbox%'
    OR LOWER(window_title) LIKE '%xshell%'
    OR LOWER(window_title) LIKE '%putty%'
    OR LOWER(window_title) LIKE '%mstsc%'
  )
  AND is_foreground = 1
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
active_bg AS (
  SELECT 
    act.timestamp,
    act.process_key,
    act.os_pid,
    act.proc_cpu_usage,
    (act.proc_disk_read_rate_mb + act.proc_disk_write_rate_mb) * 1048576 AS disk_io_bytes,
    (act.proc_network_send_kb + act.proc_network_recv_kb) * 1024 AS network_bytes,
    sf.window_title AS focus_title
  FROM public.fact_process_activity act
  JOIN sensitive_focus sf ON act.timestamp >= sf.timestamp AND act.timestamp <= COALESCE(sf.end_timestamp, sf.timestamp + interval '3 seconds')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(act.timestamp)
    AND (act.proc_cpu_usage > 5 OR act.proc_disk_read_rate_mb + act.proc_disk_write_rate_mb > 1 OR act.proc_network_send_kb + act.proc_network_recv_kb > 10)
)
SELECT 
  ab.timestamp AS "审计时刻",
  r.process_name AS "后台进程名",
  ab.focus_title AS "前台聚焦敏感窗口",
  ab.proc_cpu_usage AS "后台CPU (%)",
  ab.disk_io_bytes AS "后台磁盘 I/O",
  ab.network_bytes AS "后台网络流量",
  r.command_line AS "可疑进程命令行",
  r.executable_path AS "可疑程序路径"
FROM active_bg ab
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON ab.process_key = r.process_key
WHERE r.signature_status = 0
ORDER BY ab.timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50;

panels.title: 💀 敏感凭据/密码窗口聚焦期后台活动进程审计舱

targets.rawSql:
WITH network_active AS (
  SELECT 
    act.process_key,
    act.os_pid,
    SUM(act.proc_network_send_kb + act.proc_network_recv_kb) AS total_traffic_kb,
    MAX(act.proc_active_connections) AS max_conns,
    MAX(act.proc_remote_ip_port) AS remote_addresses
  FROM public.fact_process_activity act
  WHERE $__timeFilter(act.timestamp)
    AND (act.proc_network_send_kb > 0 OR act.proc_network_recv_kb > 0 OR act.proc_active_connections > 0)
    AND act.process_key NOT IN (
      SELECT process_key FROM public.dim_process_registry
      WHERE LOWER(process_name) IN ('chrome.exe', 'msedge.exe', 'firefox.exe', 'brave.exe', 'opera.exe', 'safari.exe', 'wechat.exe', 'feishu.exe', 'dingtalk.exe', 'claude.exe')
    )
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
foreground_windows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (process_key) 
    process_key,
    window_title
  FROM public.fact_process_context
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) 
    AND is_foreground = 1
    AND window_title IS NOT NULL AND window_title <> ''
  ORDER BY process_key, timestamp DESC
)
SELECT 
  r.process_name AS "进程名",
  n.os_pid AS "PID",
  (n.total_traffic_kb * 1024.0)::bigint AS "累计流量",
  n.max_conns AS "并发TCP连接数",
  n.remote_addresses AS "远程连接目标 (IP:Port)",
  COALESCE(f.window_title, '🚫 无前台窗口 (静默后台)') AS "聚焦窗口标题",
  r.command_line AS "执行命令行",
  r.executable_path AS "程序路径"
FROM network_active n
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON n.process_key = r.process_key
LEFT JOIN foreground_windows f ON n.process_key = f.process_key
WHERE r.signature_status = 0 OR f.window_title IS NULL
ORDER BY n.total_traffic_kb DESC
LIMIT 50;

panels.title: 🌐 静默网络外联与高危端口侦测舱

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  act.timestamp AS "连接时间",
  r.process_name AS "进程名",
  act.os_pid AS "PID",
  act.proc_remote_ip_port AS "远程 IP:Port",
  act.proc_active_connections AS "活跃连接数",
  CASE 
    WHEN r.signature_status = 1 THEN '✅ 已签名'
    WHEN r.signature_status = 0 THEN '❌ 无签名'
    ELSE '⚠️ 签名异常'
  END AS "数字签名",
  r.command_line AS "命令行参数",
  r.executable_path AS "物理路径"
FROM public.fact_process_activity act
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON act.process_key = r.process_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(act.timestamp)
  AND act.proc_remote_ip_port IS NOT NULL
  AND act.proc_remote_ip_port <> ''
  AND (
    act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:22,%' OR act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:22' OR
    act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:3389,%' OR act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:3389' OR
    act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:445,%' OR act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:445' OR
    act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:1433,%' OR act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:1433' OR
    act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:3306,%' OR act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:3306' OR
    act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:5432,%' OR act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:5432' OR
    act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:5900,%' OR act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:5900' OR
    act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:4444,%' OR act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:4444' OR
    act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:5555,%' OR act.proc_remote_ip_port LIKE '%:5555'
  )
ORDER BY act.timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  r.created_at AS "首次发现服务时间",
  r.service_name AS "绑定服务名",
  r.process_name AS "映像名",
  CASE 
    WHEN r.signature_status = 1 THEN '✅ 已签名'
    ELSE '❌ 无签名'
  END AS "数字签名",
  r.command_line AS "svchost 命令行",
  r.executable_path AS "物理路径"
FROM public.dim_process_registry r
WHERE LOWER(r.process_name) = 'svchost.exe'
  AND r.service_name IS NOT NULL
  AND r.service_name <> ''
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
  r.parent_process AS "父进程",
  r.process_name AS "可疑子进程",
  count(e.event_timestamp) AS "运行次数 (次)",
  r.command_line AS "子进程命令行"
FROM public.fact_process_lifecycle_events e
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON e.process_key = r.process_key
WHERE e.event_type = 'START'
  AND r.parent_process IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(r.parent_process) IN ('cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'wscript.exe', 'cscript.exe', 'mshta.exe', 'bash.exe', 'schtasks.exe', 'regsvr32.exe')
  AND $__timeFilter(e.event_timestamp)
GROUP BY r.parent_process, r.process_name, r.command_line
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 50;
